scenario.name: Spurious obstacle with a road user following
scenario.description: Spray, steam, blowing debris or a soiled sensor produces a false obstacle in the path while a car or motorcycle follows closely, possibly with an unbelted passenger

events.description: Brakes hard for no reason with a vehicle or motorcycle following
Brakes hard for no reason while a passenger is unbelted (foreseeable misuse)

triggers.condition: Light rain, spray thrown up by other vehicles, reflections from the wet road
Steam from vents, exhaust plumes, blowing dust or leaves
Sensors soiled or blocked by dirt, insects or water drops

goals.statement: Decelerate at least as much as needed to avoid a collision the planned trajectory avoids

scenario.meant: no hard brake for an unconfirmed object
scenario.pass: Braking that the safety channel does not confirm stays at or below the firm level; emergency braking happens only when a road user is confirmed; a blocked safety sensor is detected and Autoware stops comfortably; the belt warning acts
